columns.name: RESULT_CODE
columns.description: Status of funds check or reservation for this particular pending activity.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Activity type can be Original, Liquidation, Rounding Plug or Backout.

columns.name: ALLOC_HEADER_NUM
columns.description: For liquidations, original header.

columns.name: ALLOC_LINE_NUM
columns.description: For liquidations, original line number.

columns.name: BACKOUT_HEADER_NUM
columns.description: For backouts, backed out header.

columns.name: BACKOUT_LINE_NUM
columns.description: For backouts, backed out line number.

columns.name: BALANCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The type of balance can be Obligation, Commitment, Other, Actual or Budget.

columns.name: SUB_BALANCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Classification of balances for budget consumption

columns.name: DATA_SET_ID
columns.description: Identifies the rows processed in a run.

columns.name: PENDING_RESERVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that this is a pending transaction and that it is not a draft mode.

columns.name: AMOUNT_NOT_FOUND_CODE
columns.description: What to do if no matching budget amount is found, either Pass or Fail.

columns.name: NEGATIVE_BALANCES_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.description: For budget rows, are negative balances allowed.

columns.name: BUDGET_AMOUNT
columns.description: Initial amount budgeted to this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds reservation. Add the budget adjustment amount to get the total budget.

columns.name: BUDGET_ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount by which the budgeted amount had been increased / decreased for this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds reservation.

columns.name: COMMITMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Funds committed for this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds reservation.

columns.name: OBLIGATION_AMOUNT
columns.description: Funds obligated for this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds reservation.

columns.name: OTHER_AMOUNT
columns.description: Funds in the bucket named other for this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds reservation.

columns.name: ACTUAL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Funds spent for this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds reservation.

columns.name: FUNDS_AVAILABLE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total funds available for this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds reservation.

columns.name: PENDING_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total pending reservations for earlier transactions for this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds reservation.

columns.name: OTHER_LINES_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total pending reservations for earlier lines in this transaction for this control budget, account, and period at the time of funds reservation.

columns.name: NET_TOLERANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Tolerance allowed at the time of funds reservation.  It doesn't indicate what has been used, just records what was allowed.

columns.name: PJC_EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Project Management expenditure type identifier. This is only populated for burdening activities.

columns.name: PJC_TOP_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Project Management top resource identifier being burdened against. This is only populated for burdening activities.

columns.name: PJC_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Project Management lowest resource identifier being burdened against. This is only populated for burdening activities.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Account impacted by this activity. This is only populated for burdening activities.

columns.name: LEDGER_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount in the primary ledger's currency. This is only populated for burdening activities.

columns.name: BURDEN_LINE_FLAG
columns.description: A Yes or No flag indicating whether this line is a burdening line.

columns.name: ESTIMATED_TOLERANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Estimated tolerance amount needed for funds reservation.

columns.name: ESTIMATED_OVERRIDE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Estimated override amount needed for funds reservation.

columns.name: ESTIMATED_MAX_OVERRIDE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Estimated maximum override amount needed for funds reservation.

columns.name: JE_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: General ledger journal source (populated for general ledger and subledger accounting data only).

columns.name: JE_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: General ledger journal category (populated for general ledger and subledger accounting data only).

columns.name: CLOSED_PERIOD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the period associated with the activity is closed.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_FUNDS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether an activity has insufficient funds override considered.

columns.name: PERIOD_CHANGE_FOR_UNDO_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that the data is reversed into a different period.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
